artist.name: Em Beihold
artist.short_description: Em Beihold is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Em Beihold is an American pop singer-songwriter whose writing often makes room for wit, anxiety and deliberately unusual turns of phrase. She released music independently before the success of 'Numb Little Bug' in 2022. That track reached a large mainstream audience and became a reference point for conversational pop songs about difficult emotional states. She also appeared alongside Stephen Sanchez on a version of 'Until I Found You.' Her Egg in the Backseat project and later singles such as 'Groundhog Day,' 'Too Precious' and 'The Bird Song' established a recognizable songwriting voice. Her 2026 album Tales of a Failed Shapeshifter looks back at changing oneself to fit other people's expectations, as described in the artist's official biography. For Afterglow, Beihold widens the emotional-pop spectrum beyond breakup ballads, drawing in self-questioning, social pressure, humour and self-acceptance. The editorial mood assignments for individual tracks should remain open for review, and her guest appearance on another artist's song must be credited as a collaboration rather than misclassified as a solo recording.
